final: WITH j AS (SELECT s.transref AS tr, t.tradekind AS tk, s.optvolrt AS v FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), ov AS (SELECT AVG(v) AS o FROM j), p AS (SELECT tr, tk, AVG(v) AS av FROM j GROUP BY tr, tk), d AS (SELECT p.tr, p.tk, p.av, ABS(p.av - ov.o) AS dev FROM p, ov WHERE ov.o IS NOT NULL), ta AS (SELECT tk, AVG(dev) AS adev FROM d WHERE tk IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tk) SELECT d.tk AS tradekind, AVG(d.av) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(d.dev) AS avg_deviation, AVG(d.dev - ta.adev) AS avg_excess FROM d JOIN ta ON d.tk = ta.tk WHERE d.dev > ta.adev GROUP BY d.tk
